reproduce: python -m ratesresearch.simcal calibrate --raw RAW --cache CACHE --out cal.json; python -m ratesresearch.simcal params --cal cal.json

loadings.unit: bp of par yield per unit of factor (columns: level, slope, curvature; unit-length columns)
loadings.note: PCA of the covariance of daily par-yield changes

daily_sd.note: subperiod values are in the evidence document; the level factor ranges from 10.1 to 17.1 across the three subperiods

session_variance_share.unit: share of the daily variance that is diffusive variance inside the session
session_variance_share.note: pooled robust print volatility squared times 600 minutes over the mean daily variance of the par yields in the same window; interval = range over tenors

sd_per_sqrt_minute.unit: bp per sqrt-minute (factor units), outside event windows

idiosyncratic_sd_per_sqrt_minute.unit: bp per sqrt-minute, independent per tenor
idiosyncratic_sd_per_sqrt_minute.note: daily residual of the three-factor fit, same intraday scaling

time_of_day_multiplier.unit: multiplier of the per-minute variance, flat over the session
time_of_day_multiplier.note: the 30-minute multipliers are not stable between print subsets (evidence document, table 6); flat is used outside the event windows

release_0830.unit: extra variance per minute inside the window, as a multiple of the normal per-minute variance of every curve factor
release_0830.note: window 08:30 to 08:35 New York on days with the event; least-squares estimate rescaled to the robust variance unit by 3.29

auction_1300.unit: extra variance per minute inside the window, as a multiple of the normal per-minute variance of every curve factor
auction_1300.note: window 13:00 to 13:05 New York on days with the event; least-squares estimate rescaled to the robust variance unit by 3.29

fomc_1400.unit: extra variance per minute inside the window, as a multiple of the normal per-minute variance of every curve factor
fomc_1400.note: window 14:00 to 14:30 New York on days with the event; least-squares estimate rescaled to the robust variance unit by 3.29

daily_sd.unit: bp per day, added to every swap rate with loading 1
daily_sd.note: the measured daily change of swap minus par yield has sd 1.4 to 2.3 bp including measurement noise and 0.9 to 1.7 bp after the autocovariance correction; these are upper figures because the two legs are observed at different minutes

sd_per_sqrt_minute.note: daily_sd with the curve factors' intraday scaling

loading_by_tenor.unit: bp of swap rate per bp of factor, every tenor
loading_by_tenor.note: first component of the residual spread changes at 5, 10 and 30 years has near-equal weights; 3, 7 and 20 years have too few closing prints to test

stationary_sd.unit: bp of yield of the cheapest-to-deliver (net basis in yield terms)
stationary_sd.note: no futures data in the repository; Ornstein-Uhlenbeck

half_life.note: no futures data in the repository

market_prints_per_day_by_tenor.unit: D2C facility prints per day (strict subset)

time_of_day_share.unit: share of the day's prints per 30-minute bin from 07:00 New York (20 bins)

desk_inquiry_share.unit: desk swap RFQs per market D2C print
desk_inquiry_share.note: prints are completed trades of the whole market; the share of inquiries one dealer sees is not in the data

swap_rfqs_per_day.note: market prints per day times desk_inquiry_share

size_lognormal_by_tenor.unit: notional in USD millions: exp(N(log_mean_mm, log_sd^2)), truncated at cap_mm
size_lognormal_by_tenor.note: right-censored maximum likelihood; standard errors instead of bootstrap intervals

treasury_rfqs.unit: Treasury RFQs per swap RFQ, with the size ladder of the present presets.json
treasury_rfqs.note: no Treasury trade data (FINRA needs an account)

winner_half_spread_rms.unit: bp of yield, root mean square half-spread of the winning quote
winner_half_spread_rms.note: geometric mean of the short-gap dispersion 0.10256 [0.09619, 0.10506] (lower figure) and the long-gap dispersion 0.22707 [0.20689, 0.24585] (upper figure)

log_sd.unit: log standard deviation of a competitor's half-spread
log_sd.note: kept from presets.json; the prints do not separate dispersion across dealers from other noise

dealers_min_max.unit: dealers asked, uniform from min to max inclusive (max 5)

median_half_spread.unit: bp of yield, all tenors and sizes
median_half_spread.note: winner_half_spread_rms / 0.8353 (root mean square of the lowest of the answering quotes per unit median); expected winning half-spread = 0.139 bp

all_in_cost.unit: bp of client DV01: hedge spread, fees and capital of a competitor; equals its realised half-spread at zero profit
all_in_cost.note: lower figure 0.05 is the measured raw 5-minute realised half-spread, which misclassified sides pull towards zero

treasury_half_spread_multiple.unit: Treasury competitor median half-spread in bp of yield, as a multiple of the swap median
treasury_half_spread_multiple.note: no Treasury RFQ data; 0.5 is the ratio in the present back-test competitor model

size_and_tenor_scaling.unit: exponent of size and of tenor in the median half-spread
size_and_tenor_scaling.note: dispersion in bp of yield is flat across tenors and does not rise with size on the D2C facilities (evidence document, tables 7 and 8)

expected_adverse_move.unit: bp of yield per trade, averaged over all client trades, in the direction of the client
expected_adverse_move.note: zero-profit value: expected winning half-spread minus all_in_cost. Upper end: largest winning half-spread the dispersion supports minus the smallest realised half-spread the markouts support

informed_fraction.unit: probability that an RFQ is informed, averaged over client tiers
informed_fraction.note: only the product fraction x move is constrained by the data; 0.5 rather than the old 0.2 because a smaller fraction with a larger move makes the desk's own RFQs explain an implausible share of the level factor's variance (design document, section 6)

tier_weights_and_informed_probability.unit: weights of client tiers A, B, C; informed probabilities 0.25, 0.60, 0.975 (weighted mean = informed_fraction)
tier_weights_and_informed_probability.note: tier structure kept from the back-test synthetic day, rescaled; no client data

move_per_informed_trade.unit: bp of yield at the traded tenor, expected, delivered through the level factor

drift_time_constant.note: not identified: the signed markout changes by 0.01302 [-0.03028, 0.06032] bp between about 3 s and 5 min

measured_raw_realised_half_spread_5min.unit: bp, mean of -s (r_ref - r), all sizes, D2C strict prints
measured_raw_realised_half_spread_5min.note: attenuated towards zero by sign misclassification; a lower figure for the realised half-spread

impact_coefficient_Y.unit: dimensionless: peak impact = Y x daily sd x sqrt(quantity / daily volume)
impact_coefficient_Y.note: square-root law, Toth et al., Physical Review X 1, 021006 (2011): Y of order one on futures; not fitted to Treasuries here

impact_permanent_share.unit: share of peak impact that stays in the latent mid

impact_half_life.unit: seconds, exponential decay of the transient part and refill of consumed depth
impact_half_life.note: assumption; exponential resilience as in Obizhaeva and Wang, Journal of Financial Markets 16 (2013) 1-32

daily_volume_usd_bn.unit: USD billions per day per on-the-run Treasury on the simulated book
daily_volume_usd_bn.note: assumption; to be replaced when a Treasury volume source is added

taker_sign_skill.unit: probability above one half that another taker's trade is in the direction of the latent mid's move over the next 5 s
taker_sign_skill.note: assumption; makes resting orders adversely selected

touch_depth_usd_mm.unit: USD millions resting at the best level of the 10-year note (other instruments in proportion to daily volume); levels 2 to 5 hold 1.5, 2, 2, 2 times this

taker_trade_size_usd_mm.unit: USD millions, median of other takers' trades (lognormal, log sd 1.0)

old_constants_check.verdict: the old median half-spread is inside the range the dispersion supports; the old adverse move (0.20 bp per trade) exceeds the winning half-spread, which implies a negative realised half-spread, while the measured one is positive: outside
